observations: The page number «84» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 completes the sentence that ends p. 83 (JP2 0115, L30), «die noch die beiden Gestirne von den Stel-».

L07-L17: the two further rules of chapter 31 of the Latin text (pp. 24-25, JP2 0056-0057). Checked: 167° 8′ − 4° 15′ 45″ = 162° 52′ 15″, and + 6° 15′ 16″ = 169° 7′ 31″; 10h 55m 48s = 10.93 hours, and 10.93 × 32′ 40″ = 357.05′ = 5° 57′ 3″; 119° 10′ + 5° 57′ 3″ = 125° 7′. L17: «argumentum ratum», the «ratum argumentum» of the Latin text (p. 25, JP2 0057, L02-L03).

L18-L19 and N02: the correction for the longitude of the place (p. 25, JP2 0057, L04-L07): Suter's emendation, «oriente» and «occidente» exchanged, agrees with the check recorded on that page. L20-L22: the equation of time for converting equal hours into unequal ones (p. 25, JP2 0057, L07-L11).

L27-L33: the computation, set as the table of p. 82 (JP2 0114): five columns divided by vertical rules, not transcribed; «Dies et horae» set between the two lines of the other heads; dotted leaders after «für 25 Jahre» and «für 4 Monate», not transcribed; a rule above L32, broken at the vertical rules; L33, «= 98° 25′ 21″» and «= 0° 24′ 29″», the sums less 360°. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed. L31 and N04: the 1 of the days is printed with a short bar under it, Suter's sign that the day is to be subtracted; written {ul:1}.

L27-L33. Checked: 14d 6h 34m 9s + 4h 11m 21s + 14h 12m 9s − 1d = 14d 0h 57m 39s; 279° 28′ 28″ + 91° 37′ 55″ + 87° 18′ 58″ = 458° 25′ 21″; 29° 12′ 6″ + 185° 3′ 54″ + 77° 27′ 4″ = 291° 43′ 4″; 67° 12′ 57″ + 201° 10′ 50″ + 92° 0′ 42″ = 360° 24′ 29″. With Brahmagupta's synodic month (p. 82, JP2 0114): 300 months exceed the 25 years 1-25 of the cycle (8859 days) by 4h 11m 27s (L30: 4h 11m 21s), and the three months to the beginning of Rabīʿ II (89 days) exceed three synodic months by 9h 47m 53s, so that the time to the next opposition is shortened by that much (L31: −1d + 14h 12m 9s = −9h 47m 51s). N03: counted from 15 July 622, 1 Rabīʿ II 146 is 17 June 763.

L24: «Rabīʿ II» in italics, with the macron and the ʿayn raised; L32 and N03 upright. Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.»; italics: «M», «S», «K», «Erstens», «Zweitens», «argumentum ratum», «Beispiel», «Oppositionsberechnung.», «Opposition», «Vollmond», «oriente», «occidente».
The dashes: L09 «8′ — 4°», the long dash with a space on either side (45 px); L11 «24—25» (38 px), L22 «67—68» (49 px), L26 «70—72» (39 px) and L35 «21—26» (45 px), the long dash set close.
The colons, semicolons and the question mark stand after the thin space of the edition (11-14 px measured; «146 :» in L32, 14 px; «stattgefunden ?», 12 px).
